title: A Structural Matrix Autoregression Framework for International Spillovers
abstract: arXiv:2608.00262v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding how macroeconomic shocks propagate across countries requires structural models that can jointly identify country-specific shocks and their international transmission. Yet extending structural vector autoregressions (SVARs) to large multi-country systems is challenging due to rapidly increasing dimensionality, computational costs, and the proliferation of identifying restrictions. This paper develops a Bayesian Structural Matrix Autoregression (BSMAR) framework that exploits the natural matrix structure of international macroeconomic data. By separating dependence across economic variables from dependence across countries, the framework provides a parsimonious representation that substantially reduces the dimensionality of large structural systems. translated_title: 用于国际溢出效应的结构矩阵自回归框架
translated_abstract: 理解宏观经济冲击如何在国家间传播，需要能够同时识别国别冲击及其国际传导机制的结构模型。然而，将结构向量自回归模型（SVAR）扩展到大型多国系统面临诸多挑战，原因在于维度迅速增长、计算成本高昂以及识别约束数量激增。本文开发了一个贝叶斯结构矩阵自回归（BSMAR）框架，该框架利用了国际宏观经济数据天然具有的矩阵结构。通过将经济变量之间的依赖关系与国家之间的依赖关系分离开来，该框架提供了一种简洁的表示方式，大幅降低了大型结构系统的维度。我们开发了一种用于后验推断的贝叶斯抽样算法，该算法能够处理零约束、符号约束和排序（大小）约束，从而使已有的SVAR识别策略得以应用……
tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯结构矩阵自回归（BSMAR）框架，通过利用国际宏观经济数据的矩阵结构、将变量间依赖与国家间依赖分离，大幅降低了大型多国结构模型的维度，并支持零约束、符号约束和排序约束等多种识别方式下的贝叶斯后验推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian Structural Matrix Autoregression (BSMAR) framework that exploits the natural matrix structure of international macroeconomic data to separate cross-variable from cross-country dependence, substantially reducing the dimensionality of large multi-country structural systems while enabling Bayesian posterior inference under zero, sign, and ranking restrictions.
